facts.fact: The Ministry of Education's 'Eritrea: Basic Education Statistics 2023/24' (Asmara, December 2024) draws on annual school censuses run by Zoba education offices through standard questionnaires 7, 8 and 9, reported as normally 100% collected.

The abstract calls itself the official annual education publication of the Ministry of Education and the 26th report produced by its Department of Research and Human Resource Development; as_of is the December 2024 publication date, not the 2023/24 school year its figures cover.

systems.owner: Ministry of Education, Department of Research and HRD
